original.statement: The NodePool ConsolidationPolicy field `WhenUnderutilized` is renamed to `WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized`.

corrected.statement: NodePool's spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy value `WhenUnderutilized` is renamed to `WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized`; exposed are environments with a karpenter.sh NodePool whose spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy equals WhenUnderutilized.

decision.reason: [ev-80331c11381f] says the NodePool ConsolidationPolicy value `WhenUnderutilized` is renamed to `WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized`, so the exposed NodePools are those that still set the old value. The proposed condition reads the wrong field path, `spec.consolidationPolicy`. The CRD validator confirmed that this field lives at `spec.disruption.consolidationPolicy` in both releases [ev-09bbe26d2f4a, ev-760ae3491f13]. A check on that path would never match, so it would miss every exposed NodePool. The condition shape is otherwise right: a NodePool whose policy equals the old value. Stored v1beta1 manifests are the ones that carry it [ev-bfb089d90d84].
